notes: How the map's trees take their autumn colour (simcore/scenery/tree_tint.hpp, roadmap T5.1, docs/scenery/T5_T8_PLAN.md). Game values judged by eye against the autumn photographs (docs/scenery/TERRAIN_ROADMAP.md section 2, traits T4 and T11: black locust turning colour by late September, poplar gold and oak brown in October, the planted pine staying green). Each tree turns on its own day (onset_day plus or minus spread_days, from its position) over full_day - onset_day days; 'autumn' is the multiplier on the crown's own colour at full colour (the crown's linear vertex colours are in scenery/map_meshes.hpp), 'brightness' the share each tree's brightness varies by either way. The tree's trunk is not tinted (the material tints green-dominant vertex colours only). Leaf drop is not drawn (a later phase): a tree stays in its autumn colour through the winter. The woods' masses take the weighted mean of the deciduous kinds ('mass_mix').
